questions.question: How much does the Starter plan cost per month?
questions.gold_answer: $29 per month.

questions.question: What is the API rate limit for the Free plan?
questions.gold_answer: 60 requests per minute (per project).

questions.question: What user roles exist in a Northwind organization?
questions.gold_answer: Owner, Admin, Developer, Billing and Viewer.

questions.question: How much money do I save per year by paying for Starter annually instead of monthly?
questions.gold_answer: $58 (12 × $29 = $348 monthly vs $290 annual).

questions.question: A customer buys the Growth annual plan ($1,490) and cancels 45 days later. How much is refunded?
questions.gold_answer: $1,241.67: two months count as used (a partial month counts as full), so 10 unused months × ($1,490 ÷ 12).
questions.notes: Tests rounding of partial month and proration formula.

questions.question: How many times higher is the Starter rate limit than the Free rate limit?
questions.gold_answer: 10 times (600 vs 60 requests per minute).

questions.question: What is the current monthly price of the Starter plan?
questions.gold_answer: $29 per month (raised from $19 on 2026-01-01). The $19 figure in the archived 2025 document is outdated.

questions.question: Can I still use API v2?
questions.gold_answer: No. API v2 was shut down on 2026-03-31 and now returns 410 Gone; use v3.

questions.question: How old can a webhook timestamp be before I should reject it, and has that changed?
questions.gold_answer: More than 5 minutes old should be rejected. The tolerance was reduced from 10 minutes to 5 minutes on 2026-03-02.

questions.question: I'm on the Starter plan and want SAML single sign-on. What do I need to do and what would it cost?
questions.gold_answer: SAML SSO is available on Enterprise only, so you must move to an Enterprise plan, which has custom pricing with a minimum of $1,200 per month.

questions.question: A Growth customer paying $149/month had a single 3-hour outage in a 30-day month and no other downtime. Do they get a credit, how much, and how do they claim it?
questions.gold_answer: 3 hours = 180 minutes of 43,200, so uptime is about 99.58%, below the 99.9% commitment but above 99.0%, giving a 10% credit ($14.90). It is not automatic: they must open a support ticket within 30 days after month end; the credit is applied to a future invoice, not paid in cash.

questions.question: My Python code gets 413 errors uploading 30 MB files on Starter. What are my options?
questions.gold_answer: The Starter payload limit is 10 MB. Options: compress or split the file, or upgrade to Growth (50 MB limit, $149/month).

questions.question: What is the rate limit?
questions.gold_answer: It depends on the plan: Free 60/min, Starter 600/min, Growth 3,000/min, Enterprise 10,000/min by default (up to 100,000). Sandbox (nw_test_) keys are 100/min on any plan. A good answer lists these or asks which plan.
questions.notes: Underspecified question; tests whether the system surfaces the plan dependence.

questions.question: Can I get a refund?
questions.gold_answer: It depends: within 14 days of the first paid charge, a full refund; monthly plans are otherwise non-refundable; annual plans get a prorated refund if cancelled within 90 days; overage charges are never refundable.

questions.question: Is a 4-hour Sev2 response guaranteed for Growth customers?
questions.gold_answer: Not by default: the Growth Sev2 first-response target is 8 business hours. 4 hours (24/7) applies only with the Premier Support add-on. Also, targets are for first response, not resolution.

questions.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.gold_answer: An Owner goes to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Paid features remain until the end of the paid period, then the account reverts to Free.

questions.question: How do I verify a webhook signature?
questions.gold_answer: Read X-Northwind-Signature (t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>). Compute HMAC-SHA256 of '<timestamp>.<raw request body>' with your endpoint secret, compare it with v1, and reject if the timestamp is older than 5 minutes.

questions.question: What do I need to change to migrate from API v2 to v3?
questions.gold_answer: Change /v2 to /v3, replace the X-API-Key header with Authorization: Bearer, switch from page to cursor pagination, and handle v3's string error codes.

questions.question: Does Northwind offer an official Ruby SDK?
questions.gold_answer: Not stated in the documentation. The documented SDKs are Python, Node.js and Go.
questions.notes: Correct behavior: say it is not documented; may mention the three documented SDKs.

questions.question: Is Northwind Cloud FedRAMP authorized?
questions.gold_answer: Not stated in the documentation. The docs list SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR/CCPA, and HIPAA/PCI notes only.
